# I Like Movies

> I Like Movies is a free movie and TV tracking app for Android and iOS that
> helps you discover what to watch next, share one library with the people you
> live with, and keep a record of everything you have seen.

I Like Movies is an independent app built by one developer in Romania. It is
free to download and free to use, carries no advertising, and shows no
sponsored recommendations.

## What it does

- **Discovery**: recommendations built from your own ratings and viewing
  history rather than a general popularity chart, plus curated collections that
  group films by franchise or series in watch order.
- **Assistant**: an in-app chat you can ask for a film in plain language, by
  mood, by a fragment of a plot, or by something you liked. It reads your watch
  history so it does not suggest what you have already seen, and it answers
  with titles available in your country.
- **Households**: the people you live with share one library. A single
  watchlist and a single watched history for the whole home.
- **Friends**: follow people, compare taste, and see what they are watching.
- **Tracking**: ratings, private notes and rewatches for films and TV, with
  episode level progress for series.
- **Streaming availability**: which services carry a title, resolved for your
  country rather than a single global catalogue.
- **Imports**: a Letterboxd .zip export or an IMDb .csv export uploads directly,
  bringing ratings and watchlist across.

## Availability and price

- Android: available on Google Play. Package name `com.moviesagent.app`.
- iOS: in development, not yet on the App Store.
- Price: free. No advertising, no sponsored placements.
- Requires an internet connection; there is no offline mode.

## How it differs from similar apps

- **Letterboxd** is a social network built around public film reviews and
  criticism. I Like Movies is private by default and built around deciding what
  to watch, and it adds TV episode tracking, per-country streaming availability,
  a shared household library, and a plain-language assistant.
- **Trakt** centres on automatic scrobbling from media servers and players. I
  Like Movies needs no server or plugin chain; it is a phone app for choosing
  what to watch, with a library the household shares.
- **TV Time** focuses on TV episode tracking. I Like Movies treats films and TV
  as one library and leads with discovery, with no advertising.
